description: This file provides functions to fetch a project's name from a backend API endpoint, with a fallback mechanism. It exports two functions: fetchProjectNameDirect and a deprecated alias fetchProjectNameByProjectId.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameDirect
methods.description: Fetches the project name using a specific API endpoint, with fallback to base URL if API client is unavailable.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId
methods.description: Deprecated alias for fetchProjectNameDirect, retained for backward compatibility.
